title: GitHub PRs · large
useWhen: Review a consequential change with a concrete example, risks, and rollout evidence.
avoidWhen: The extra sections repeat the diff or add no useful review context.

data.title: Reduce the test runner memory peak
data.text:
## Problem and result
The job loaded every bundle at once and exceeded its memory limit. Bounded batches keep the same tests within the limit.

## Example
The sample peak falls from 1.8 GB to 1.1 GB. Runtime falls from 148 s to 92 s.

## Validation
- Identical spec inventory before and after.
- Focused checks pass.
- Full CI and review remain pending.

## Risk and rollout
The runner could omit a batch if discovery changes. Compare the discovered and executed spec counts before release. Revert the runner change if parity fails.

heightUseWhen: A detailed graph, status panel, table, or bounded report.
heightAvoidWhen: A smaller preset fits the information without overflow.
